title: Canonical source-time-bound inputs for the EXP-20260821-033 leak-free predraw baseline

proposal_scope.title: Canonical source-time-bound inputs for the EXP-20260821-033 leak-free predraw baseline
proposal_scope.hypothesis: 固定済みmetadata-bound JRA/history/Recovery入力とEXP-20260821-033契約だけを用い、単一のdeterministic default-deny canonicalizerを別途承認されたreal-data Runで実行すれば、2026-08-23 WIN5の5レース・70 declared runner identityを保持しつつ、training/target generator-input releaseをsource-time、schema、label eligibility、content hashまで再現可能に固定し、target result、future、draw-dependent、market情報を混入せずEXP-033のrun scopeへ結合できる。
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: いずれかのsource hash、必須field、source_event_time、received_at、available_as_ofを検証できない、5レース・70 identityまたはstatus reconciliationに失敗する、training/target generator schemaが一致しない、label作成にsilent drop・rank renumber・tie-breakが必要になる、target resultまたはfuture/market情報が混入する、あるいは同一入力からhashを再現できないため、certified releaseを出力できずEXP-20260821-033はblockedのままである。
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The declared, active-as-of, and supervised-label universes determine field size, current-card race aggregates, and which completed events may enter strictly shifted horse history. Source-time-bound card, status, jockey, weight, and result events preserve those legitimate pre-race mechanisms while preventing post-race filtering, future-row use, or fabricated rank order. Canonicalization adds no predictive signal; it makes the existing EXP-033 mechanism auditable and is designed to fail if authoritative provenance is unavailable.
proposal_scope.target_population: Metadata-defined JRA flat turf/dirt history partitions frozen by EXP-20260821-033 through 2026-02-15, an audited history extension through 2026-08-09 used only after source-time proof, and the five uniquely resolved 2026-08-23 WIN5 races with the audited baseline of 70 declared race_id x horse_id identities. The predraw baseline preserves 44 scheduled_pending_draw and 26 confirmed entries; target labels are absent. No real row is opened at proposal or Prepare stage.

Any use of netkeiba, non-finite canonical value, duplicate JSON key, or unbound input byte

No distinct verified GitHub Issue comment exactly matching APPROVED_TO_RUN plus a later canonical run-scope digest
No verified GitHub Issue comment exactly matching APPROVED_TO_PREPARE plus this proposal digest
Research OS ordinary real-data RUNNING remains unable to bind execution_kind in a versioned canonical run contract
